sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: Today, Rabbit Hole, Episode 7.
sentences.zh: 今天是《兔子洞》第七集。

sentences.en: Kevin?
sentences.zh: 凯文？

sentences.en: Yes, Allie's here.
sentences.zh: 是的，艾莉在这儿。

sentences.en: Hi, Kevin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，凯文。

sentences.en: Hey, Allie.
sentences.zh: 嘿，艾莉。

sentences.en: Thanks for participating in our goat rodeo here.
sentences.zh: 感谢你参与我们这儿的“山羊竞技”节目。

sentences.en: I love this subject, so happy to do it.
sentences.zh: 我热爱这个主题，非常乐意参加。

sentences.en: Can you first, can you just sort of introduce yourself and your beat these days?
sentences.zh: 你能先简单介绍一下你自己以及你最近负责的报道领域吗？

sentences.en: So I'm Allie Watkins.
sentences.zh: 我是艾莉·沃特金斯。

sentences.en: I work at the Metro Desk at the Times, and my beat is largely the New York City Police Department, but that encompasses a whole lot of things, whether it's crime, counterterror,
sentences.zh: 我在《纽约时报》都市新闻部工作，主要负责纽约市警察局的相关报道，但这涵盖了非常广泛的内容，无论是犯罪、反恐，

sentences.en: or we had a big spike in gang violence this year in Brooklyn, so we kind of hop around to all of that.
sentences.zh: 还是今年布鲁克林帮派暴力事件激增，我们都会追踪报道。

sentences.en: And this story, the story you're here to talk about, where does it start for you?
sentences.zh: 那么这个故事，也就是你今天要讲的故事，是从哪里开始的呢？

sentences.en: So it starts late on the night of March 13th this past year, when I started getting frantic phone calls from my editor around 1130 at night,
sentences.zh: 故事始于去年3月13日深夜，当时我大约在晚上11点半接到编辑打来的急促电话，

sentences.en: and I think when you're on the Metro Beat and you're covering the police department, you get calls at that time of night and you think, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想，当你负责都市新闻和警局报道时，在那个时间点接到电话，你通常会觉得，你知道的，

sentences.en: either a bridge is blown up or, like, a mob boss is dead.
sentences.zh: 要么是哪座桥被炸了，要么就是某个黑帮大佬死了。

sentences.en: And it turns out it was the second one.
sentences.zh: 结果发现是后者。

sentences.en: In a brazen shooting straight out of a crime drama, 53-year-old Francesco Frankie Boy Calley was found with multiple gunshots.
sentences.zh: 在一场如同犯罪剧般猖狂的枪击案中，53岁的弗朗切斯科·“弗兰基小子”·卡利被发现身中数枪。

sentences.en: Francesco Calley.
sentences.zh: 弗朗切斯科·卡利。

sentences.en: Francesco Frankie Boy Calley, gunned down last night.
sentences.zh: 弗朗切斯科·“弗兰基小子”·卡利，昨晚遭枪杀。

sentences.en: Known as Frankie Boy Calley, who is the underboss of the Gambino crime family.
sentences.zh: 他被称为“弗兰基小子”·卡利，是甘比诺犯罪家族的二把手。

sentences.en: The Gambino crime family was once led by the legendary John Gotti.
sentences.zh: 甘比诺犯罪家族曾由传奇人物约翰·戈蒂领导。

sentences.en: Is dead in Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 死于斯塔滕岛。

sentences.en: ...the scene of the biggest mob hit in three decades.
sentences.zh: ……这是三十年来最大的一起黑帮暗杀现场。

sentences.en: This is the first time a mob boss has been killed in New York City since 1985.
sentences.zh: 这是自1985年以来，纽约市首次有黑帮大佬被杀。

sentences.en: Shakespeare said of kings, uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.
sentences.zh: 莎士比亚曾谈到国王时说：欲戴王冠，必承其重。

sentences.en: The same might be said of those who rise to the top of organized crime.
sentences.zh: 这句话用在那些爬到有组织犯罪顶端的人身上也一样。

sentences.en: They get there by violence, and often as not they leave by violence.
sentences.zh: 他们靠暴力上位，也往往以暴力收场。

sentences.en: And, you know, in the immediate aftermath of a mob murder like that, you know, there's a million things you're trying to figure out,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在像这样一起黑帮谋杀案发生后的第一时间，有无数的事情需要你去弄清楚，

sentences.en: and the biggest one is, who killed him, and oh my God, are there going to be more bodies dropping?
sentences.zh: 而最重要的问题是：谁杀了他？天哪，还会有人遇害吗？

sentences.en: Is this going to be some kind of mob war?
sentences.zh: 这会引发某种黑帮战争吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: I'm joined here today with Lieutenant Charlie Francis, the CO of the 122nd...
sentences.zh: 今天和我在一起的是第122分局的指挥官查理·弗朗西斯中尉……

sentences.en: A few days after that call from my editor, after we've spent days trying to understand what happened...
sentences.zh: 在接到编辑电话几天后，在我们花了几天时间试图了解事情经过之后……

sentences.en: Earlier today, members of the Detective Bureau, together with our partners in the region...
sentences.zh: 今天早些时候，侦探局的成员与我们在该地区的合作伙伴一起……

sentences.en: The police finally announced that they have a suspect.
sentences.zh: 警方终于宣布他们有了嫌疑人。

sentences.en: ...posed into custody, a 24-year-old male, Anthony Camelo.
sentences.zh: ……已将其拘留，是一名24岁的男子，安东尼·卡梅洛。

sentences.en: And had you ever heard the name Anthony Camelo before?
sentences.zh: 你之前听说过安东尼·卡梅洛这个名字吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: And, you know, after we get that name, it sets off this frantic scramble to figure out who this kid is, and what, if any, connection he may have had to Cali or the mafia.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在我们得到这个名字后，引发了一场疯狂的搜寻，试图弄清楚这孩子是谁，以及他与卡利或黑手党之间有什么联系（如果有的话）。

sentences.en: So we started trying to figure out if his family was connected to the mob at all.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始调查他的家人是否与黑帮有任何关联。

sentences.en: Like, we knew they lived in Staten Island, we knew his dad had been involved in construction, which has historically been mob-controlled.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们知道他们住在斯塔滕岛，我们知道他父亲曾从事建筑业，而该行业历来受黑帮控制。

sentences.en: We also knew that Anthony had a history with drugs, and that his brother had an alleged history with drugs.
sentences.zh: 我们还知道安东尼有吸毒史，而且他兄弟也有涉嫌吸毒的记录。

sentences.en: So, did they somehow cross Cali because of that?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们是因为这个而与卡利产生冲突了吗？

sentences.en: And there was this theory out of left field that Anthony had some kind of romantic interest in Frank Cali's niece, and that Frank Cali had told him to stay away.
sentences.zh: 还有一个出人意料的理论，说安东尼对弗兰克·卡利的侄女有某种浪漫想法，而弗兰克·卡利曾警告他离远点。

sentences.en: But, none of these really panned out.
sentences.zh: 但是，这些说法都没有得到证实。

sentences.en: There are new developments in the murder of a reputed mob boss at Staten Island.
sentences.zh: 关于斯塔滕岛一位知名黑帮大佬被谋杀一案，有了新的进展。

sentences.en: So, Anthony Camelo is arrested on Saturday.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·卡梅洛于周六被捕。

sentences.en: The suspected killer making his first court appearance in New Jersey today.
sentences.zh: 这名嫌疑杀手今天在新泽西州首次出庭。

sentences.en: He shows up in court on Monday.
sentences.zh: 他周一出现在法庭上。

sentences.en: In charge of Anthony A.
sentences.zh: 关于安东尼·A·卡梅洛的指控，

sentences.en: Camelo being a fugitive on the county of Richmond, the state of New York.
sentences.zh: 他是纽约州里士满县的逃犯。

sentences.en: He walks into this court hearing.
sentences.zh: 他走进法庭参加听证会。

sentences.en: It's the first time any of us are really seeing him in person.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次真正亲眼见到他。

sentences.en: And what does he look like?
sentences.zh: 他看起来怎么样？

sentences.en: He looks really grizzled, you know, his hair is really unkempt.
sentences.zh: 他看起来非常憔悴，你知道，头发乱糟糟的。

sentences.en: He's in this thick, striped, green and white jumpsuit.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件厚实的绿白条纹连体服。

sentences.en: Is it true that you're waiting for your right for extradition?
sentences.zh: 你是在等待引渡权利吗？这是真的吗？

sentences.en: Yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 是的，长官。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: He sits down at the witness stand.
sentences.zh: 他在证人席上坐下。

sentences.en: He's got his cuffs on.
sentences.zh: 他戴着手铐。

sentences.en: Is that a guess?
sentences.zh: 那是猜测吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And at a certain point, he raises his left hand.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，他举起了左手。

sentences.en: You see, drawn in the middle of his hand with like a ballpoint pen, is this huge Q.
sentences.zh: 你看，他手心用圆珠笔画着一个巨大的字母Q。

sentences.en: The letter Q.
sentences.zh: 字母Q。

sentences.en: The letter Q.
sentences.zh: 字母Q。

sentences.en: As in QAnon.
sentences.zh: 就像“匿名者Q”（QAnon）那样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How do I tell when I'm being manipulated?
sentences.zh: 我该如何判断自己是否被操纵了？

sentences.en: There are so many videos like that.
sentences.zh: 有太多那样的视频了。

sentences.en: What's real and what's not.
sentences.zh: 什么是真的，什么不是。

sentences.en: It has to be true.
sentences.zh: 这一定是真的。

sentences.en: They are shutting down the discussion.
sentences.zh: 他们正在关闭讨论。

sentences.en: So if we're looking to answer the question of what the internet is doing to us.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们想回答互联网对我们做了什么这个问题。

sentences.en: Our reality that we've been taught in school and that we've been told on the mainstream media and all this for so many years, it's been false.
sentences.zh: 我们多年来在学校里学到的、在主流媒体上被告知的现实，其实都是虚假的。

sentences.en: There might be no better place to look than QAnon.
sentences.zh: 可能没有比“匿名者Q”更好的观察对象了。

sentences.en: So what is Q?
sentences.zh: 那么Q是什么？

sentences.en: You should instead be asking who is Q?
sentences.zh: 你应该问的是：谁是Q？

sentences.en: Because even though like on the surface, this community, it seems totally fringe.
sentences.zh: 因为尽管表面上看，这个群体似乎完全处于边缘地带。

sentences.en: I believe there is someone out there putting information on the internet.
sentences.zh: 我相信有人在互联网上发布信息。

sentences.en: I believe that somebody who's trying to awaken the public to what's really going on in the world.
sentences.zh: 我相信那个人正试图唤醒公众，让他们了解世界上真正发生的事情。

sentences.en: In some ways, QAnon is the logical conclusion of everything that's happened on the internet.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，“匿名者Q”是互联网上发生的一切的逻辑终点。

sentences.en: Cyberspace opens up a whole new world for you.
sentences.zh: 网络空间为你打开了一个全新的世界。

sentences.en: It's cool.
sentences.zh: 这很酷。

sentences.en: The idea was to maximize what you're saying at all.
sentences.zh: 其初衷是最大化你所说的一切。

sentences.en: It's tapped a yearning to connect.
sentences.zh: 它触动了人们渴望连接的心理。

sentences.en: If Jeff knew who I was, we'd be friends.
sentences.zh: 如果杰夫知道我是谁，我们就能成为朋友。

sentences.en: We certainly have gotten better at predicting what people are interested in.
sentences.zh: 我们在预测人们感兴趣的事物方面确实做得更好了。

sentences.en: We have such a large voice, and I don't think they understand.
sentences.zh: 我们有如此大的话语权，我不认为他们理解这一点。

sentences.en: It's all wrapped up in the story of Q.
sentences.zh: 这一切都包裹在Q的故事里。

sentences.en: The general population is going to be awoken.
sentences.zh: 大众将会觉醒。

sentences.en: I mean, they're just, it's going to be hard for people to process.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们只是……人们将很难消化这些信息。

sentences.en: And that story really starts in 2016.
sentences.zh: 而那个故事确实始于2016年。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks has released a batch of more than 2,000 hacked emails from the account of Hillary Clinton's campaign chairman, John Podesta.
sentences.zh: 维基解密发布了超过2000封从希拉里·克林顿竞选主席约翰·波德斯塔账户中窃取的电子邮件。

sentences.en: It was a few months before the election, and WikiLeaks had just published this trove of emails from top Democrats, including Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 那是大选前几个月，维基解密刚刚发布了这批来自民主党高层（包括希拉里·克林顿）的邮件。

sentences.en: The leak revealed transcripts from some of Clinton's paid Wall Street speeches.
sentences.zh: 泄露的内容揭示了克林顿一些付费华尔街演讲的文字记录。

sentences.en: These are the emails we now know were hacked by Russia.
sentences.zh: 这些邮件我们现在知道是被俄罗斯黑客窃取的。

sentences.en: Mrs. Clinton suggesting that Wall Street insiders are best equipped to help reform the financial sector.
sentences.zh: 克林顿夫人暗示华尔街内部人士最适合帮助改革金融部门。

sentences.en: You went to Wall Street and told them they should regulate themselves?
sentences.zh: 你去华尔街告诉他们应该自我监管？

sentences.en: And there were all these stories in them about how these emails revealed...
sentences.zh: 邮件里有各种关于这些内容揭示了什么的故事……

sentences.en: Clinton told a private trade union gathering that extreme environmentalists need to, quote, get a life.
sentences.zh: 克林顿在一次私人贸易工会聚会上说，极端环保主义者需要“活得现实点”。

sentences.en: Hillary Clinton privately contradicting some of her public statements.
sentences.zh: 希拉里·克林顿私下里与她的一些公开声明相矛盾。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks showed us that Hillary was given an unfair advantage from the get-go, and Bernie was given a disadvantage.
sentences.zh: 维基解密向我们展示了希拉里从一开始就获得了不公平的优势，而伯尼则处于劣势。

sentences.en: And how Democratic Party officials had been working behind the scenes to support her nomination.
sentences.zh: 以及民主党官员是如何在幕后运作以支持她的提名的。

sentences.en: Look, it proves all of us conspiracy theorists.
sentences.zh: 看，这证明了我们这些阴谋论者是对的。

sentences.en: You know, they made fun of us for a long time, saying that we were delusional, and this just confirms what we knew, which was...
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们嘲笑我们很久了，说我们有妄想症，而这证实了我们所知道的，那就是……

sentences.en: And while this was a big story in the media...
sentences.zh: 虽然这在媒体上是个大新闻……

sentences.en: The chair of the DNC has announced her resignation.
sentences.zh: 民主党全国委员会主席已宣布辞职。

sentences.en: And it was big online, too.
sentences.zh: 这在网上也引起了轰动。

sentences.en: These people are deciding to steer an entire party, which is 50% of a political process.
sentences.zh: 这些人决定操纵整个政党，而这占了政治进程的50%。

sentences.en: Because there's no...
sentences.zh: 因为没有……

sentences.en: This is old, old, old shit.
sentences.zh: 这都是陈芝麻烂谷子的破事儿。

sentences.en: That what's new is technology.
sentences.zh: 新鲜的是技术。

sentences.en: In a certain corner of the internet, it took off in a completely different direction.
sentences.zh: 在互联网的某个角落，它朝着一个完全不同的方向发展。

sentences.en: What we began to see were oddly worded emails that focused around food and seemed to be code for something else.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到一些措辞奇怪的电子邮件，它们围绕着食物，似乎是其他事物的暗语。

sentences.en: People on message boards like 4chan and Reddit...
sentences.zh: 4chan和Reddit等留言板上的人们……

sentences.en: Is something else going on here?
sentences.zh: 这里面还有别的事吗？

sentences.en: It's just, it's a little bit weird.
sentences.zh: 这只是……有点奇怪。

sentences.en: ...started finding what they saw as secret codes.
sentences.zh: ……开始寻找他们眼中的秘密代码。

sentences.en: Searching this guy's emails is a never-ending job for researchers like myself.
sentences.zh: 搜索这个人的邮件对于像我这样的研究人员来说是一项永无止境的工作。

sentences.en: Especially in these emails from Clinton's campaign chairman, John Podesta.
sentences.zh: 特别是在克林顿竞选主席约翰·波德斯塔的这些邮件中。

sentences.en: First off, I think the most suspicious thing is that you just type in pizza, you have 149 results.
sentences.zh: 首先，我认为最可疑的是，你只要输入“披萨”，就会有149个结果。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I don't know how many people eat pizza or talk about it in their emails.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我不知道有多少人会在邮件里吃披萨或谈论它。

sentences.en: I know I don't.
sentences.zh: 我知道我不会。

sentences.en: Like, they thought it was suspicious how often John Podesta or someone he was emailing referred to pizza.
sentences.zh: 比如，他们认为约翰·波德斯塔或他邮件往来的人提到披萨的频率很可疑。

sentences.en: Now, pizza, cheese pizza, is slang, very old internet slang for child pornography.
sentences.zh: 现在，“披萨”、“奶酪披萨”是俚语，是非常古老的互联网俚语，指代儿童色情。

sentences.en: And eventually, in these message boards and then spilling out onto Twitter...
sentences.zh: 最终，在这些留言板上，然后蔓延到推特上……

sentences.en: They actually repeatedly used this food terminology.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上反复使用了这种食物术语。

sentences.en: So, hot dog equals boy, pizza still equals girl, cheese equals little girl.
sentences.zh: 所以，热狗等于男孩，披萨仍然等于女孩，奶酪等于小女孩。

sentences.en: That's the latent evidence that these guys are involved in a pedophile ring.
sentences.zh: 这就是这些人参与恋童癖团伙的潜在证据。

sentences.en: People started claiming that these pizza references were evidence of a vast criminal conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 人们开始声称这些关于披萨的引用是一个巨大犯罪阴谋的证据。

sentences.en: And then if we find an attachment in an email with the I'm With Her logo...
sentences.zh: 然后如果我们在一封带有“我支持她”（I'm With Her）标志的邮件中找到附件……

sentences.en: From one James Olifantes.
sentences.zh: 来自一个叫詹姆斯·奥利凡特的人。

sentences.en: James Olifantes turns out to be the owner of a restaurant called Comet Ping Pong.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·奥利凡特原来是一家名为“彗星乒乓”餐厅的老板。

sentences.en: And we're like, well, what's Comet Ping Pong?
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，嗯，什么是“彗星乒乓”？

sentences.en: Lo and behold, it was an actual pizza place.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，那是一家真正的披萨店。

sentences.en: This is what became known as Pizzagate.
sentences.zh: 这就是后来被称为“披萨门”的事件。

sentences.en: Pizzagate, or related hashtags, were shared more than a million times on Twitter in just five weeks.
sentences.zh: “披萨门”或相关标签在短短五周内就在推特上被分享了超过一百万次。

sentences.en: People actually believe a conspiracy theory that Hillary Clinton and her former campaign manager,
sentences.zh: 人们真的相信了一个阴谋论，即希拉里·克林顿和她的前竞选经理，

sentences.en: John Podesta, ran a child sex ring at a pizzeria in D.C.
sentences.zh: 约翰·波德斯塔，在华盛顿特区的一家披萨店经营着一个儿童性交易团伙。

sentences.en: And it really reached its peak when someone took it seriously enough to try to stop it.
sentences.zh: 当有人认真对待并试图阻止它时，它达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: A North Carolina man arrested in a D.C.
